summary: The first notes of the meeting belong to a temporary secretary whose own job is still up for a vote.
realLife: Micah Rowland appointed Neil Shafer-Ross temporary secretary at opening; the 21st District caucus later elected him permanent secretary by voice vote.
inGame: needs: temporary designation and election result.

turns.pulledBy: The same person wins the permanent job.
turns.what: They continue the record under their elected title.
turns.writesBack: The minutes show when the change took effect.
